title: Name a repeated policy literal
why: A repeated threshold, duration, or capacity literal can drift because its purpose is not named.
suggestion: Define one purpose-named constant near the behavior that owns this policy.
limitations: Candidates are compared only across sibling source files; comments, purpose-named uppercase constant declarations, arithmetic expressions, generic min/max calls, collection length comparisons, bare `count` identifiers, common integer sentinels, and digits embedded in identifiers, numeric types, or Duration factory names are excluded.

Rust Duration factory names participate in the grouping concept, so identical numbers with different units are not conflated. This remains lexical policy advice, not resolved identity of business concepts; unnamed durations with the same constructor and value can serve different purposes.
